Query/synchronize process handle stays pinned; critical/unverifiable or different-session processes reject. Neutralize input before WM_CLOSE without activation; bounded 0-10000ms grace. Force only on explicit human request, through original pinned process while original window still matches, then up to 2000ms exit wait. No launcher/child/tree targeting. Window loss, identity change, cancellation, expiry or F12 prevents later force; posted close cannot be recalled. Pinning prevents PID reuse retargeting; Windows identity check and HWND message post are separate operations, not an atomic guarantee against concurrent HWND replacement.
